answer.rationale: Verify the prior evidence that a second source protected allocation during a shortage. With the line at 94% of committed volume and no buffer, avoiding single-source exposure is more important than immediately adopting the low-cost quote as the sole supply source. A guarded second-source qualification or allocation preserves delivery resilience while allowing the cost-saving path to be tested; the mandate may not be fully achieved until the sourcing mix and realized costs are confirmed.
